entities.name: Ambogliflozin
observations: The provided question describes ambogliflozin as an SGLT-2 inhibitor, but direct PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov name searches returned no matching records; supplied trial evidence is unverified.

entities.name: Reported retinopathy reduction
observations: The supplied abstract reports diabetic retinopathy in 7% versus 12% (RR 0.6, 95% CI 0.4–0.9); this is the only listed answer-choice outcome with a statistically significant difference, but the purported evidence is unverified.

entities.name: PMID:27501010
observations: 2016 HepG2 γ-irradiation study of low-dose hyper-radiosensitivity and Cdc25C-linked G2/M control; DOI:10.1080/09553002.2016.1206235.

entities.name: HepG2 HRS-Cdc25C association
observations: In HepG2 cells, γ radiation <0.3 Gy induced HRS; 0.3, 0.5, and 2 Gy caused G2/M arrest. Total Cdc25C was unchanged, while phospho-Cdc25C rose at 6, 16, and 24 h after 0.5 or 2 Gy, peaking at 16 h. Results support association, but the abstract reports no Cdc25C perturbation establishing causality.
